```{r}
sps_list = c("Adig", "Ahya", "Amur", "Fspp", "Gfas", "Hcoe", "Pcru", "Pdam", "Plut", "Spis", "Xesp")
oga <- read.table(
    "/home/data/Chenxi/workplace/scRNAseq/cross_species_scRNAseq/final_data/broccoli/Anthozoa_all_genome_260426/orthogroup_conservation.csv",
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE,
    quote = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
oga_filtered <- oga %>%
    filter(species %in% sps_list)%>%
    select(-c(gene_name, orthogroup_name))

for(spi in sps_list){
    annot_fn= sprintf("./260428_gene_annote_all_genome/annot.%s.genes.csv", spi)
    annot_df <- read.table(annot_fn, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    gene_to_spis<- dic_from_vecs(annot_df$gene, annot_df$spis_ortholog)
    gene_to_name<- dic_from_vecs(annot_df$gene, annot_df$orthogroup_name)
    gene_to_unip<- dic_from_vecs(annot_df$gene, annot_df$Uniprot_name)
    gene_to_tf<- dic_from_vecs(annot_df$gene, annot_df$is_tf)
    oga_filtered$spis_ortholog[oga_filtered$species==spi]<- gene_to_spis[oga_filtered$gene[oga_filtered$species==spi]]
    oga_filtered$Mmus_name[oga_filtered$species==spi]<- gene_to_name[oga_filtered$gene[oga_filtered$species==spi]]
    oga_filtered$Uniprot_name[oga_filtered$species==spi]<- gene_to_unip[oga_filtered$gene[oga_filtered$species==spi]]
    oga_filtered$is_tf[oga_filtered$species==spi]<- gene_to_tf[oga_filtered$gene[oga_filtered$species==spi]]
}
write.table(oga_filtered, 
              file = "orthogroup_annotation.csv", 
              sep = "\t", 
              row.names = FALSE, 
              quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
           Uniprot_gene_2, frequency_2_uniprot,
           Uniprot_gene_3, frequency_3_uniprot) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(starts_with("Mmus_name_"), starts_with("Uniprot_gene_")),
        names_to = "source_rank",
        values_to = "annotation"
    ) %>%
    filter(!  is.na(annotation) & annotation != "") %>%
    mutate(
        source = ifelse(grepl("Mmus", source_rank), "Mmus", "Uniprot"),
        rank = as.integer(str_extract(source_rank, "\\d+"))
    ) %>%
    # 添加对应的频率
    left_join(
        og_annotations_final %>%
            select(orthogroup,
                   frequency_1_mmus, frequency_2_mmus, frequency_3_mmus,
                   frequency_1_uniprot, frequency_2_uniprot, frequency_3_uniprot) %>%
            pivot_longer(
                cols = starts_with("frequency_"),
                names_to = "freq_col",
                values_to = "frequency"
            ) %>%
            mutate(
                source = ifelse(grepl("mmus", freq_col), "Mmus", "Uniprot"),
                rank = as.integer(str_extract(freq_col, "\\d+"))
            ) %>%
            select(orthogroup, source, rank, frequency),
        by = c("orthogroup", "source", "rank")
    ) %>%
    select(orthogroup, tf_ratio, annotation, frequency, source, rank)
```

```{r}
# 为每个 orthogroup 选择 first 和 second annotation
select_annotations <- function(og_data) {
    
    orthogroup <- og_data$orthogroup[1]
    tf_ratio <- og_data$tf_ratio[1]
    
    # 移除重复的注释（保留频率最高的）
    candidates <- og_data %>%
        group_by(annotation) %>%
        slice_max(frequency, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        arrange(desc(frequency))
    
    # 初始化结果
    first_annotation <- NA_character_
    first_support <- NA_real_
    second_annotation <- NA_character_
    second_support <- NA_real_
    
    # ========== 场景 1: TF 比率 >= 0.8 ==========
    if (tf_ratio >= 0.8) {
        
        # 找包含 ":" 的 Mmus 注释
        tf_annots <- candidates %>%
            filter(source == "Mmus" & grepl(":", annotation))
        
        if (nrow(tf_annots) > 0) {
            # 使用第一个 TF 注释
            first_annotation <- tf_annots$annotation[1]
            first_support <- tf_annots$frequency[1]
            
            # 寻找 second annotation（频率 > 0.5，且不是 first）
            other_annots <- candidates %>%
                filter(annotation != first_annotation & frequency > 0.5) %>%
                arrange(desc(frequency))
            
            if (nrow(other_annots) > 0) {
                second_annotation <- other_annots$annotation[1]
                second_support <- other_annots$frequency[1]
            }
        }
    }
    
    # ========== 场景 2: 其他情况 ==========
    if (is.na(first_annotation)) {
        
        # 找频率 > 0.5 的注释
        high_freq <- candidates %>%
            filter(frequency > 0.5)
        
        if (nrow(high_freq) > 0) {
            
            # 如果有多个相同频率，优先选 Uniprot
            high_freq <- high_freq %>%
                arrange(desc(frequency), desc(source == "Uniprot"))
            
            first_annotation <- high_freq$annotation[1]
            first_support <- high_freq$frequency[1]
            
            # second annotation:  除 first 外频率最高且 > 0.2
            other_annots <- candidates %>%
                filter(annotation != first_annotation & frequency > 0.2) %>%
                arrange(desc(frequency))
            
            if (nrow(other_annots) > 0) {
                second_annotation <- other_annots$annotation[1]
                second_support <- other_annots$frequency[1]
            }
            
        } else {
            # 没有 > 0.5 的注释
            # first 保持 NA
            # second 选频率 > 0.2 的最高
            mid_freq <- candidates %>%
                filter(frequency > 0.2) %>%
                arrange(desc(frequency), desc(source == "Uniprot"))
            
            if (nrow(mid_freq) > 0) {
                second_annotation <- mid_freq$annotation[1]
                second_support <- mid_freq$frequency[1]
            }
        }
    }
    
    # 返回结果
    tibble(
        orthogroup = orthogroup,
        first_annotation = first_annotation,
        first_support = first_support,
        second_annotation = second_annotation,
        second_support = second_support
    )
}

# 测试函数
test_og <- all_candidates %>% filter(orthogroup == "OG:009272")
select_annotations(test_og)
```

```{r}
# 对每个 orthogroup 应用函数
og_final_annotations <- all_candidates %>%
    group_by(orthogroup) %>%
    group_modify(~select_annotations(.x)) %>%
    ungroup()

# 查看结果
head(og_final_annotations, 20)

# 添加 has_TF 列
og_final_annotations <- og_annotations_final %>%
    select(orthogroup, tf_ratio) %>%
    left_join(og_final_annotations, by = "orthogroup") %>%
    mutate(
        has_TF = tf_ratio > 0
    ) %>%
    select(
        orthogroup,
        has_TF,
        first_annotation,
        first_support,
        second_annotation,
        second_support
    )

head(og_final_annotations, 30)

# 检查有多少 orthogroup 没有候选注释
missing_ogs <- og_annotations_final %>%
    filter(! orthogroup %in% og_final_annotations$orthogroup) %>%
    select(orthogroup, tf_ratio) %>%
    mutate(
        has_TF = tf_ratio > 0,
        first_annotation = NA_character_,
        first_support = NA_real_,
        second_annotation = NA_character_,
        second_support = NA_real_
    ) %>%
    select(-tf_ratio)
cat(sprintf("\n缺失的 orthogroup: %d\n", nrow(missing_ogs)))
write_tsv(og_final_annotations, "./260428_orthogroup_annotate/orthogroup_final_annotations.csv")
```

```{r}
# 统计注释情况
annotation_stats <- og_final_annotations %>%
    summarise(
        total_ogs = n(),
        
        # first annotation
        with_first = sum(! is.na(first_annotation)),
        pct_first = with_first / total_ogs * 100,
        
        # second annotation
        with_second = sum(!  is.na(second_annotation)),
        pct_second = with_second / total_ogs * 100,

        # with either annotation
        with_either = sum(! is.na(first_annotation) | !is.na(second_annotation)),
        pct_either = with_either / total_ogs * 100,
        
        # has_TF
        n_with_tf = sum(has_TF),
        pct_with_tf = n_with_tf / total_ogs * 100,
        
        # both annotations
        with_both = sum(! is.na(first_annotation) & !is.na(second_annotation)),
        pct_both = with_both / total_ogs * 100
    )

print(annotation_stats)

# 按 has_TF 分组统计
og_final_annotations %>%
    group_by(has_TF) %>%
    summarise(
        n_ogs = n(),
        with_first = sum(! is.na(first_annotation)),
        with_second = sum(! is.na(second_annotation)),
        pct_first = with_first / n() * 100,
        pct_second = with_second / n() * 100,
        .groups = "drop"
    )
```
